title: 5740-NG rank 10
problem: Rank 10's 'took no damage' counter also counts avoided and dodged hits (rank 100)
notes: Hook spec: research/handoff_eval.md Batch R: not built. 'Didn't take any damage' should ignore every prevented hit (rank-100 avoid, dodges, Prevented!), not just rank 100's; needs hooks at each prevention exit of bc_EventDamage to undo the L66 damages += 1. Round-2 hook (A2): at the turn-start reset of `damages` (bc_CreatureStartOfTurn L54) each party creature's damage_taken is snapshotted; the rank-10 `damages == 0` read (bc_CreatureEndOfTurn L210) sees 0 unless damage_taken grew since. In-game test: 5740-NG rank 10 (and 100): when every enemy hit is avoided or dodged, the relic still attacks at the end of that enemy's turn; after a hit that deals damage it doesn't.

release_notes.intended: The relic attacks when the bearer took no damage during an enemy's turn.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, avoided, dodged and prevented hits counted as damage taken, so the attack was lost.
release_notes.fix: Now only hits that really deal damage stop the attack.
